scope: English chat source exposure; not deployed enablement or successful execution
conditions: Gateway authentication and scope checks always apply.
Capability inputs are branch-dependent, not an all-of authorization list.
Status, confidence, missing slots and complete-request checks precede dispatch.
Registry-only implementations are not proof of live chat exposure.

search.behavior: Catalog discovery with validated constraints and selection.

product_fact.behavior: Exact product identity and current authoritative facts; missing facts stay unknown.

comparison.behavior: Compare verified products; ambiguous identities require selection.

comparison_clear.behavior: Clear browser comparison state; no commerce mutation.

cart_action.behavior: Supported cart/wishlist commands; checkout intents only guide checkout.

wishlist_remove.behavior: Remove an exact owned item or explicitly all saved items (up to 100); ambiguous requests need selection.

wishlist_to_cart.behavior: Scoped transfer with authoritative outcomes; source and destination are preserved.

order.behavior: Read owned orders; issue intents may provide guidance.

reorder.behavior: Read owned order and hand off for review/checkout; no order write from chat.

locations.behavior: Saved-address reads or form/control guidance; no automatic address mutation.

support.behavior: Read owned tickets; changes remain guided.

bestsellers.behavior: Read authoritative completed-order sales ranking for an allowed period.

context.behavior: Request a complete instruction or explicit context control.

guided_action.behavior: Guide review in the customer workflow; no direct mutation.
